bart_summary: Peking opera singer Liu Guijuan posted pictures of her headdress on Weibo. It was made from the feathers of no less than 80 kingfishers. She said she bought the rare headpiece more than a decade ago for 120,000 yuan (£10,775) Two of the 11 types of kingfisher in China are protected species.

Ryanair and Aer Lingus engage in light-hearted banter on Twitter. Ryanair posts photo of staff in Terminal 2 at Dublin Airport. Aer LingUS responds by saying 'Fly from T2 at @DublinAirport to central locations across Europe. T1 gets you nearly there, we get you really there'

David Alaba was injured while playing for Austria in their 1-1 draw against Bosnia-Herzegovina on Tuesday. The 22-year-old is set to start rehabilitation work in about a month. Bayern Munich face Porto in the Champions League quarter-finals later this month.

Warren Weinstein's family paid money to his captors, a Pakistani source says. It did not lead to the American aid worker's release, and he was inadvertently killed in an anti-terror strike. After the transfer of funds in 2012, the captors began demanding prisoners be released in exchange for Weinstein.

Novak Djokovic lost his cool at the end of the second set of the Miami Open final against Andy Murray. The world No 1 grabbed a towel from the ball boy who seemed startled by the loud confrontation. The youngster was caught in the crossfire of a tirade at his support team during his win over Murray in Sunday's final. The Serbian issued an apology via Facebook.

Lazio beat Napoli 1-0 on Wednesday to reach the Coppa Italia final. They will now face Juventus in the final on June 7. Defender Mauricio captured the Lazio fans celebrations using a selfie stick. Lazio face Empoli in Serie A on Sunday.

Jacob Polyakov cracked his head after plunging off the edge of the SEC 'Globe' centre in Kiev, Ukraine. His friend Jamal Maslow, who fell off the roof first, broke his coccyx after landing on the corner of one of the steps. Witnesses rushed over to the teenagers, both 17, after the accident and found Mr Maslow in huge amounts of pain.

Floyd Mayweather Jnr and Manny Pacquiao will fight on May 2 in Las Vegas. American television network Showtime has released a short promotional video from within the Mayweather camp. Mayweather is down to within three-and-a-half pounds of the welterweight limit ahead of mega-fight.

Steven Sloan, joined by friends Michael Niccum and Eugene Dight were on an aluminium rowboat when the encounter occurred off the west coast of Anderson Island, Washington. The group believe that the sound of the rope being pulled along the side of the boat is what attracted the orcas.

New technique harnesses the power of the body’s immune system and targets it at tumours. Early experiments have demonstrated that the new method could revolutionise cancer care. Scientists are now recruiting patients with skin cancer for the first clinical trial on humans. British experts said it is the most promising sign yet that ‘personal’ treatments may be effective in treating a wide range of cancers.

The 73-year-old woman suffered severe bruising to her legs and ribs. Her blue Vauxhall Corsa collided with railings on the petrol forecourt of the Asda store in Hulme, Manchester. She was waiting from an ambulance with her husband, who has dementia, when the thief sneaked into her car and stole the black Garmin device. A member of the public took a photograph of the suspect as he left the scene.

The attempted break-in took place in Pemberton, a suburb of Wigan in Greater Manchester. One of the robbers used a sledgehammer to smash through an internal wooden door. The other used a axe to smash security glass at Uncle Jewellers and Pawn Brokers. When a worker barricaded the door and pushed one of them back through the broken window they fled the scene.

Loganair flight from Aberdeen to Shetland was struck by lightning. autopilot ignored pilot's commands to climb and tried to crash the plane into the sea. Pilot wrestled back control just moments before it was about to crash into the icy water. The aircraft landed safely in Aberdeen with only minor damage and no injuries.

The video was taken of a routine skydive in Everöd, Sweden and recorded on the helmet of one of the divers. The camera slips from helmet and makes its stomach-churning plunge to the ground. Remarkably, the camera remains intact despite falling from the great height.

Elephants are often seen travelling single file, using their trunk to hold onto another mammal’s tail in front of them. But one young elephant decided to go it alone, when it walked alongside its herd and even broke their chain. Captured at Whipsnade Zoo, the video shows keepers assisting six elephants along a path.

Loren Mathieson filmed her pet Boston Terrier, Gizmo, performing the gravity-defying stunt one day at home. Footage shows him taking a few steps forwards before planting down his front feet and launching his back legs vertically in the air. To date the video of his circus-like trick has been watched more than 80,000 times.

James Oliver, 48, was left with a serious leg injury after being allegedly hit by a car driven by Linda Currier, 53. Police report that they found Oliver in the driveway of a home in Noblesboro, Maine, on Saturday night. Currier was arrested for operating under the influence and aggravated assault - she was later released on bail pending a court appearance. Oliver was previously convicted of sexual abuse of a minor and rape, according to the Maine Sex Offender Registry.

Footage shows 27-year-old Jared Henry of Arkansas being knocked off his longboard to the ground while the doe spins on its stomach into a ditch. The deer apparently broke its pelvis and died while Henry recovered from the incident unscathed. The pro-sportsman was shooting a video for the Fayettechill outdoor clothing brand.

Troy Deeney opened the scoring for Watford in the 37th minute. Odion Ighalo scored his 19th goal of the season in the second half. Middlesbrough have now lost four of their past five away games. Aitor Karanka's side remain top of the Championship.

Cody got stuck in the bog in Belvedere, south-east London. Fire crews worked for an hour and a half to free the distressed animal. The horse was covered head to hoof in mud after being dragged to safety. He has been taken back to the stables to be seen by a vet.

Wildlife photographer Einar Gudmann caught the violent encounter on camera. He had been sleeping in his warm shelter when he was suddenly woken by howling. After emerging into the bitter sub-zero temperatures, he spotted a female and male fox copulating. But the pair weren't alone - a third Arctic fox lurked nearby. Without warning the single fox emerged and began to growl and howl at the pair. Wiggling free, the female ran for the hills while the two male foxes began to fight.

Mary Kay Letourneau Fualaau was a 34-year-old teacher and mother of four in 1996. She began an affair with her 13- year-old student, Vili Fuala Pau. She gave birth to her lover's child and went on to serve more than seven years in prison.

Susie Clark found a 3.69-carat white, teardrop-shaped diamond at Crater of Diamonds State Park. It's the 122nd diamond found at the park so far this year. Visitors get to keep what they find at the state park's 37.5-acre search field.

Quinn Patrick was on a fishing trip with his dad at Snow Lake, Indiana. The pair caught a bowfin, videoed lying lifeless on a concrete dock. Quinn deliberates whether someone should put it back in the water. When suddenly the Bowfin propels itself from the ground and slaps the youngster straight in the face with its large tail.

Paul Gregory, 51, claimed exercise left him breathless, despite being a keen walker and member of a mountaineering club. He was exposed when Bedford Borough Council staff read an article in The Westmorland Gazette, describing how the 'experienced walker' had been attacked by cows in Cumbria. He pleaded guilty to two counts of dishonestly obtaining a blue badge by misrepresenting his physical abilities at Luton Magistrates' Court. Gregory was fined £795 and ordered to carry out 150 hours of unpaid work.

Vanessa Santillan's body was found in a £400,000 flat in Fulham, London. The 33-year-old, who worked as a transgender escort, died as a result of injuries to the head and neck. A man, 23, has been arrested in connection with her death but has been bailed. Scotland Yard is appealing to anyone who may have had contact with her before her death.

PSG lost 2-0 to Barcelona in the Champions League last 16 second leg. Edinson Cavani has struggled in the shadow of Zlatan Ibrahimovic. The 28-year-old has scored 18 goals for the Ligue 1 side this season. Manchester United are said to be monitoring his situation closely.

Tesla founder Elon Musk has unveiled a $3,000 (£1,980) battery. He claims it can run an entire home for eight hours. Powerwall is three feet wide and four feet tall, and weighs 220lbs. It can be installed either on an outside or inside wall of a home. The technology powers up overnight when electricity rates are cheaper. Users can then switch the battery on during the day to use the home.

intruders broke into a home in Hatfield Peverel, Essex, flooded the kitchen, dumped the TV in a bath filled with water and slashed sofas and chairs. They stole jewellery including a wedding ring and watches, a computer, laptop and tablet from the house and left thousands of pounds in damage. The group even stopped for some toast - leaving bread and butter out on the sideboard.

Kayonna Cole filmed the moment at her home in Los Angeles. She remains calm throughout the video, but later suffered a reaction to the spider's venom. Kayonna said that the particular type of tarantula has low toxicity venom similar to that of a bee sting.

Vessel has been used by the US Office for Naval Research for more than 50 years. It is used to measure underwater acoustics as well as water temperature. It can be also used for oceanography, meteorology and marine mammal observation. The vessel can accommodate five crew and up to eleven researchers for up to 30 days.

John Bramblitt, 42, developed epilepsy aged 11 which slowly caused him to lose his eyesight. At the age of 30, the artist from Denton in Texas was completely blind. Despite this, he decided that an inability to see should not prevent him from painting. The artist uses a special technique to transfer the scene which he imagines onto the canvas.

Researchers at Vanderbilt University in Tennessee explored how best to minimise the risk of infection after surgery. Study revealed that soft toys brought into the operating theatre by children served as a breeding ground for bacteria. Researchers urged parents to wash and sterilise their child's toys before bringing them into the theatre.

Chelsea host Manchester United in the Premier League on Saturday. Jose Mourinho's men are seven points clear at the top of the table. Louis van Gaal's United have won four games in a row without Angel di Maria. Juan Mata could return to haunt his former club after being pushed out at Stamford Bridge.

Fascinating video shows twisting groups of magnetic fields writhing around. They are essentially twisted bundles of magnetic field that extend out of and back into the surface across hundreds of kilometres. As common structures in the solar corona, they are thought to be the main cause of several types of solar weather - including solar flares and CMEs.

Wayne Rooney suffered a knee injury during Manchester United's defeat by Everton at Goodison Park on Sunday. The England international was replaced by Robin van Persie in the closing stages of the Premier League clash and was seen receiving treatment on the bench. Louis van Gaal confirmed after the game that Rooney had sustained the injury but that it was too early to know the severity.

As the world awaits the impending birth of William and Kate's second baby, potential names have become the topic of rampant speculation and heated debate. Girls' names are causing the biggest stir, as there seems to be a belief that the couple are expecting a princess. If the assumptions are correct, she will be the first Princess of Cambridge born into the royal family in 182 years.

Misty Machinshok, 33, has been jailed for 15 to 30 years for the abuse. She 'coached' the pair on the best positions to conceive, and held her daughter's hand 'the first few times' She planned to tell friends and family that the teenager got pregnant with a stranger at a house party in their home town of Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania. Her 29-year-old husband, who she met on onlinebootycall.com, will be sentenced this month after pleading no contest to raping the child 'every few days' throughout 2013.

Debenhams and Mothercare have called a halt to long-running promotions. Experts claim prolonged sales can devalue products and encourage shoppers to delay buying an item until it is reduced. A third of all fashion purchases are now made in a sale or promotion. There have been warnings that shoppers are being ‘trained’ not to buy at full price, undermining profits.

The unnamed worker was spotted on the roof 30-feet above the ground on top of an Edwardian semi-detached home in Greenwich, south east London. A local resident noticed the man carrying out the work with a lack of safety equipment on the slippery tiles and quickly took snaps of the man. The image was then passed to the Health and Safety Executive, who attended the property and caught the man doing the same thing.

Gisele Bundchen announced her retirement from the catwalk last weekend. She is the face of Chanel and Carolina Herrera and has her own line of lingerie. "I want to be with my family more and focus on special projects," she said in an interview.

Up to 21 million acres of jungle will be torn down to make way for rubber plantations in the next decade alone. The demand is putting endangered gibbons, leopards and elephants in south east Asia at risk. The tyre industry consumes 70 per cent of all natural rubber grown. Rising demand for vehicle and aeroplane tyres is behind the recent expansion of plantations.

Britain's Adam Peaty has broken the men's 100 metres breast stroke world record with a time of 57.92 seconds at the London Aquatic Centre. The 20-year-old from Uttoxeter's gold-winning time on Friday beat the previous record of 58.46 set by South African Cameron van der Burgh in the same venue at the 2012 Olympics.

The nine-year-old boy was whipped with a skipping rope by his adoptive mother. He was also beaten with metal rods and water pipes, leaving scars. Photographs of the child's horrific injuries were shared online. His adoptive mother Li has been arrested on suspicion of child abuse.

Jondrew Lachaux, from Las Vegas, is married to the teenager's mother 38-year-old Kellie Phillips. They have six children together while the teen is from another relationship. She gave birth in her mom's bed - she did not have any medical help and did not take the newborn to the hospital. The teen ran out of food and began to suffer from malnutrition. She stopped breastfeeding after two months because she was so undernourished and switched to baby formula. It was during this period that the three-year old died - the cause of the death is under investigation.

Long tailbacks built up on both sides of the carriageway as a stretch of the motorway between junctions four and five in Ortford, Kent was closed. But during the hour-long delay today, Kent Police received reports that people started kicking a ball about. Police tweeted warning motorists to remain inside their vehicles.

Traffic had started to build up on the M58 around Switch Island on Merseyside when a silver Mercedes attempted to undertake the trafffic. But a Renault driver wasn't happy and pulled into the inside lane to block the Mercedes from moving forwards. The incident was captured on a dashcam by a passing motorist and posted to Youtube by a user called Lancashire Dashcam.

Sandstorms caused havoc in Saudi Arabia last week with a number of flights being cancelled and schools being forced to close. Strong winds are believed to have caused the disruption, which resulted in nearby Dubai’s skyline almost disappearing and people suffering from respiratory problems. Mohammed Mohsen captures the orange cloud getting thicker as it disperses and engulfs the road. The video concludes with the filmmaker moving the camera around to show the sheer capacity of the cloud.

Randy Johnston, 68, from Dallas, Texas, decided to leave two 'fake poops' on his granddaughters' beds. His son then went about filming the moment of discovery. But footage shows that the prank turned out to be decidedly disastrous, with Randy's six-year-old granddaughter Porter getting red-faced and dramatically crying in horror.

Italian artist Johannes Stoetter has painted two naked women to look like a chameleon. The 37-year-old has previously transformed his models into frogs and parrots. Stoetter daubed water-based body paint on the models to create the multicoloured effect. The finished result existed only briefly before the models were able to get up and wash the paint off.
